title: 宽边换脚
description: 彩铅画中，一只宽脚点上的轻巧换脚成为画面的细节。

art_direction.medium: fine pen and transparent watercolor on warm paper
art_direction.scene: Create an original colored-pencil illustration centered on a fictional adult carefully exchanging feet on a wide low foothold. Both hands remain on secure amber holds, and the wall is vertical with a compact route arranged for short controlled movements. The incoming shoe approaches the available side of the foothold without an airborne hop. Include enough of the adult's torso and face to convey concentration, while retaining the entire lower body and broad empty crash mat in a medium-wide composition. Use textured cream paper, turquoise pencil shadows, and earthy clothing colors. All garments are opaque. No captions, logos, falling, high exposure, or crowded landing zone.
